text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey—! Ho—!

text_block_list.name: Participants
text_block_list.text: Hey—! Ho—!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hey—! Ho—! Everybody now!

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
(Incredible, Helios... Hehe. 
...Seeing everyone enjoy themselves warms my heart.)

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: (—Ruby too... She is truly radiant.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Oh... Zephyr, where is your dress?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Time to change soon.
But... before that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san.
May I have this dance?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
——!
With me...?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Wanted to be first to ask.
My special, precious friend, Miracle-san.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. You are dear to me too.
——With pleasure.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Fufu~ Pleasant breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
La~la~lalala~♪
Come, join me.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text:
La~la~lalala~♪
Ahaha, tempo is quite fast...!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Yes, heart racing. Warmth...
Like being wrapped in spring breeze.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: ...Miracle-san, anyone else you wish to dance with?

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: ——Eh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Want to dance with someone special" ——that feeling,
graceful breeze. Fulfilled my wish. Now your turn.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Sure our bond, like breeze... may scatter.
Even so... deeply precious.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Want you happy too.
Want your wishes granted too.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Surely deep inside you feel it.
Even if wrapped in freezing winds.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Um... sorry, do not quite understand...

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
Miracle-san.
Decided to be clearing wind.

text_block_list.name: K.S. Miracle
text_block_list.text: Eh——?
